changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Preserve media metadata snapshots when media rows are inserted, updated, or deleted.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION media_file_audit_trigger_function() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' OR TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN INSERT INTO media_file_audit( audit_version, operation, changed_at, id, file_id, cre_date, exif_gps_location_long, exif_gps_location_lat, exif_gps_location, exif_gps_date, exif_date_image_taken, camera_make, camera_model ) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(audit_version), 0) + 1 FROM media_file_audit WHERE id = OLD.id), TG_OP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, OLD.id, OLD.file_id, OLD.cre_date, OLD.exif_gps_location_long, OLD.exif_gps_location_lat, OLD.exif_gps_location, OLD.exif_gps_date, OLD.exif_date_image_taken, OLD.camera_make, OLD.camera_model; ELSIF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN INSERT INTO media_file_audit( audit_version, operation, changed_at, id, file_id, cre_date, exif_gps_location_long, exif_gps_location_lat, exif_gps_location, exif_gps_date, exif_date_image_taken, camera_make, camera_model ) VALUES ( 1, TG_OP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NEW.id, NEW.file_id, NEW.cre_date, NEW.exif_gps_location_long, NEW.exif_gps_location_lat, NEW.exif_gps_location, NEW.exif_gps_date, NEW.exif_date_image_taken, NEW.camera_make, NEW.camera_model ); END IF;
IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER media_file_audit_trigger AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON media_file FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION media_file_audit_trigger_function()
